author: anon
text: Unknown car parked outside the corner store two nights in a row. Plate not recognized. Keep your eyes open.

author: Pelon
text: Heard the next block is recruiting. Could be they're running low.

author: La Sombra
text: Meeting at the Flats Friday night. Everyone shows up and brings what they know.

author: anon
text: Someone was going in and out of the old garage around 3 AM. Not sure who.
